channel.title: Reflections With Fr. Leo Clifford
channel.desc: Surely these words of wisdom find an echo in your heart this day. "I shall pass this way but once. Any good I can do, any kindness I can show, let me not defer it, let me not neglect it. Let me do it now, because I shall not pass this way again.". (10 minutes).
